HelicopterCapacity.definition: Number of patients that can be transported by helicopter in one trip

HelicopterTripTime.definition: Time taken for one helicopter trip

BusCapacity.definition: Number of patients that can be transported by bus in one trip

BusTripTime.definition: Time taken for one bus trip

MinPatients.definition: Minimum number of patients that need to be transported

MinHelicopterTripPercentage.definition: Minimum percentage of trips that should be by helicopter

MaxBusTrips.definition: Maximum number of bus trips allowed
